accessRequired: Meeting content access must be verified.
heading: Decision management
emptyDescription: The server returned no records for this status and page.
discardCreate: Discard unsaved decision content and evidence?
confirmSuccess: Decision confirmed as an official record
rejectSuccess: Decision rejected and preserved in history
checkBeforeRetry: Check the refreshed official decisions before explicitly allowing a new attempt.
verifyFailed: Could not verify official decisions. Creation remains unresolved.
reviewUnauthorized: Decision review is no longer authorized.
reviewCurrent: Review the current proposal before submitting.
freshEvidence: This proposal needs fresh, matching transcript evidence before confirmation.
editUnauthorized: Decision editing is no longer authorized.
reviewConfirmed: Review the current confirmed decision again.
invalidLength: Decision content must be between 1 and 5,000 characters.
createUnauthorized: Decision creation is no longer authorized.
resolvePrevious: Resolve the previous creation outcome before submitting.
transcriptChanged: The transcript changed while evidence was selected. Review the evidence again.
reviewEvidenceAgain: Transcript evidence must be reviewed again before creating this decision.
previousRequest: The previous request may have created an official decision. Check the refreshed confirmed decisions before trying again.
proposalDescription: Confirming makes this an official organizational decision. Rejecting preserves the AI proposal as historical record.
reviewBlocked: This review is no longer actionable. No action was replayed.
unverified: The record could not be verified on the refreshed page. Close this review and reopen it from the authorized collection.
confirmBlocked: Confirmation is unavailable because the evidence is missing, stale, unsafe, or could not be verified against the current transcript. Rejection remains available.
correctDescription: Only content changes are submitted. Status, evidence, provenance, and meeting ownership remain server-controlled.
correctionBlocked: The correction cannot be submitted until the latest decision has been reviewed. Your draft is preserved.
locateLatest: Locate the decision in the refreshed collection and select Correct content to review its latest snapshot.
newDescription: This creates an official human decision. Supporting evidence is optional and must come from the current authorized transcript.
noSegments: No transcript segments are available for selection.
